messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: EdgeOps IslandCloud <edgeops@islandcloud.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Air-Gap Delivery: Signed Artifact Transit & Acceptance Protocol

Hi Sergio / EdgeOps team,

We’re preparing the bundle for the Acme Utilities pilot (private, air-gapped deployment). Attached are the signed artifact stub (signature file only) plus the manifest and checksums. Before we ship physical media we want to agree the handoff/verification steps so the site team can validate without direct network access.

High-level ask: confirm you can perform the acceptance steps below and share any additional constraints from the courier or import process at Acme.

Proposed acceptance flow (short):
- Redwood creates bundle and produces: bundle.tar.gz, bundle.sig (PKCS7 detached), artifact_manifest.json, and md5_checksums.txt.
- We will escrow signature using a customer-provided verification public key (KMS-exported certificate) and include the signing key fingerprint in the manifest.
- Courier delivers tamper-evident media to Acme secure facility; Acme provides time-stamped delivery receipt.
- On site, Acme runs offline verification: (a) verify signature against provided public key, (b) validate checksums, (c) run smoke acceptance tests from 'onprem-acceptance-checklist.pdf'.
- If verification passes, Acme replies with signed confirmation PDF and chain-of-custody photo stub to our secure Drive. If not, they return media to Redwood for investigation.

Attachments: redwood_signed_bundle_v1.tar.gz.sig (signature only), artifact_manifest-v1.json, md5_checksums.txt, onprem-acceptance-checklist.pdf

Notes/questions:
1) We plan to sign with our HSM RSA-4096 key; is Acme able to consume a PKCS7 detached signature and/or verify SFV/md5?
2) Is there a preferred courier partner you require (we can use CagedTransit or SecureParcel)?
3) Any additional customs or import paperwork we should pre-generate to avoid delays?

Thanks — please reply with any changes or ACK to proceed with shipment on Feb 3 PST.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: S. Perez <sperez@islandcloud.io>

Date: 2028-02-02T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Air-Gap Delivery: Signed Artifact Transit & Acceptance Protocol

Karthik — thanks for the detail. Quick answers inline and a couple of requests.

Inline:
- We can consume PKCS7 detached signatures. Our validation toolchain supports verification against a provided cert or an RSA PEM. Please include the cert in DER and PEM form in the manifest or as a companion file.
- MD5 is acceptable as a second sanity check but we’ll require SHA256 as primary; can you add sha256sum values?
- We work with SecureParcel and CagedTransit; SecureParcel has a faster SLA to Acme’s region (2 business days).

Requests/observations:
1) Chain-of-custody photos are mandatory for Acme — we’ll need the courier to capture tamper seals at pickup and delivery.
2) The on-site acceptance runner will be a small VM image that executes the checklist; please ensure the runbook includes exact command invocations and timeouts for long-running unpack/verify steps.
3) For legal imports: Acme requires a declaration of media contents and a copy of the signature cert to clear their internal compliance desk.

I’ll attach our verification checklist and a sample courier manifest next email. If you can add SHA256 to the manifest and attach the public cert we can schedule pickup Feb 3 afternoon.

— Sergio Perez
EdgeOps Lead, IslandCloud
sperez@islandcloud.io

Karthik / Hannah — good questions from EdgeOps. Operational items I’ll own:
- I’ll schedule SecureParcel pickup for Feb 3 15:00 PST and confirm courier SLA and photo policy.
- Ops will create a secondary file with SHA256 hashes and include the PEM/DER public cert in the package.
- I want a contingency: if verification fails on-site, courier will quarantine media at Acme and await return instructions; do we have an expedited reprovisioning slot if we need to rebuild and reseal?

Hannah: can you please get legal to pre-approve the declaration language (short blurb for customs) and make sure we have a signed DocuSign envelope (linked) from Acme acknowledging acceptance criteria? I’ve looped Markus for a quick leadership-approved exception if the site needs an unscheduled reseal.

Marissa / team — thanks for owning the logistics. I approve the contingency reseal slot (one expedited rebuild window) on a case-by-case basis for the Acme pilot. A few governance points before pickup:

1) Signing policy: Redwood will publish the signing key fingerprint to the manifest and rotate signing keys with 6-month cadence; for this pilot we will notarize the signing cert with our HSM audit entry id (HSM-AUDIT-2028-02-01).
2) Verify that the manifest includes BOTH SHA256 and MD5 (SHA256 primary). EdgeOps should run strict-fail on checksum mismatch.
3) Emergency rollback: if Acme detects tampering or signature mismatch, treat media as compromised — stop deployment and raise a Sev2 to Platform Security.

Please proceed with pickup Feb 3 as planned and confirm once media is in transit. I’ll join the post-delivery signoff call if needed.

Markus Klein
VP, Platform & Product Security, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
